text_block_list.text:
URA Finals. The race in which each horse 
girl is in peak condition, competing for 
the top.
Its qualifying round was about to begin.

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text: Thank you, trainer, for seeing <chrname> here.

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
At last, you have come this far. As a fan 
of both of you, I'm happy.
choice_data_list: I'm going to make this the best race ever!

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, yes. I'm looking forward to it!

The gates of the URA Finals are finally 
open!
